issues.detail: The post-sync commit 74c2da0 changes src/export.js outside any workflow transition while STATE stays at AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. This is a plausible manual edit, and it is exactly what makes the sync identities outdated. The verification report and both reviews also cite the old export.js blob, which is consistent with the scenario and gives Navigator more stale evidence to explain, not a contradiction.

summary: Both discrepancies are real and independent in the built repository. CONTEXT.md wrongly names src/server.js as the listening entry point, while src/main.js has been the start script since a pre-cycle commit. The COMPLETE synchronization record claims every identity matches, yet a later commit changed src/export.js. The checks (CONTEXT/sync unchanged, WorkflowState unchanged) and the Navigator invariants cannot fail a correct read-only run, nothing leaks the answer, and both assertions are observable.
